comparator.name: Geneeskunde
comparator.sourceNotes: The 180 EC Epicurus bachelor has no separate formal route. Four recurring organ-system themes combine with academic and professional strands. The official study programme sets credits and confirms the placement, restricted 18 EC elective space, medical thesis and final practice block. The dated assessment programme corroborates the structure. UvA student guidance documents progression and the methodology requirement before the thesis.

progressionAssessment.rationale: Biomedical and brain/behaviour gateways precede all dependent courses. Cell biology, physiology, biochemistry and anatomy precede advanced pathology and pharmacology where feasible. Research Methods & Statistics precedes experimental statistics and the meta-analysis seminar. Formal prerequisites and exact planned availability pass. Data handling occurs before final-year evidence synthesis. Psychopathology is placed before Psychodiagnostics & Psychotherapies as a useful advisory progression.

alternativeSelection.assessment: Two evidence-supported options share biomedical and research foundations and differ in purpose and by at least 30 EC. The third direction would combine healthcare science and environmental courses without enough healthcare-specific integration. This coherence finding is separate from course planning.

comparisonAlignment.rationale: Both address cardiovascular, pulmonary and renal function. Human Physiology supplies normal systems physiology; it does not reproduce the patient-centred medical theme.
Infection & Immunity directly addresses immune regulation, host defence and immunopathology, an important part of the integrated regulation theme; hormonal and metabolic scope is not reproduced.
Both address cardiovascular, respiratory and renal disease. UvA develops clinical reasoning in patient cases.

notes.text: UvA combines biomedical science with supervised patient experience, clinical reasoning and medical skills. The UCR options cover biomedical or behavioural aspects of health. Patient placements, medical skills training and preparation for clerkships remain specific to the Medicine programme.

audience.programmeDescription: Medicine at the University of Amsterdam studies disease and patient care through four recurring clinical themes. Students complete supervised placements, medical skills training and a bachelor’s thesis.
audience.comparisonExplanation: The closest UCR option focuses on biomedical disease mechanisms and research. The second brings together cognition, behaviour and social perspectives on health. Both share scientific topics with Medicine, while UvA trains students to assess and care for patients.
